snippet.title: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure - Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon. 

Demo & Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2851050/Mops__Mobs_A_Sweeping_Dungeon_Novel

Get your job in Mops & Mobs, you can
👻Talk to the monsters
🧹 Decorate their quarters
⚔️ Fight card battles
🔍 Investigate a looming threat
👾 Have retro feelz

Music by  @MCTannhaeuser 
Characters by @jolottschannel 

More from the project: https://ratking.de/blog
Official site: https://mopsmobs.ratking.de 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ratkinggames
TikTok: www.tiktok.com/@ratkingentertainment
